meta.title: My Son Sanctuary Day Trip from Hoi An | Guide & Tips for visiting the Cham Temple
meta.description:
Beautiful My Son Sanctuary Temple | A Day Trip From Hoi An, Vietnam

Welcome to our day trip to the beautiful My Son Sanctuary Temple! Join us as we explore this ancient and stunning UNESCO World Heritage Site, just a short journey from Hoi An, Vietnam. Discover the rich history and intricate architecture of the My Son Sanctuary, a cluster of Hindu temples that stand as a testament to the Champa civilization. Walk through the lush, scenic surroundings and marvel at the detailed carvings and impressive ruins. Whether you're a history buff, an architecture enthusiast, or simply looking for a memorable adventure, this day trip from Hoi An to My Son Sanctuary is a must-do. Stay tuned for an unforgettable exploration!

comments.text: Want to see our full 3 week Vietnam adventure? Check out our travel vlog next: https://youtu.be/k3Zk9R4Llxo

comments.author: @erinuber2881
comments.text: Hello Tim and Dennis!  The My Son Sanctuary Temple is so beautiful!  I'm glad you were able to visit it on your trip.  It's sad to see it decaying, but it seems oddly appropriate that the jungle plants are growing among the statues and bricks.  I'm glad the Temple is still used, and you were able to see cultural performances there.  This was such a wonderful trip, and I'm glad you were both able to go.  Have a wonderful weekend!  Hugs!

comments.author: @stufr.travel
comments.text: It was so stunning.  We absolutely loved the plants taking over the buildings.  They maintain it very well luckily.   We wish you a great weekend too 😍❤️. Hugs from us

comments.author: @Scriptor13
comments.text: Such amazingly intricate stone/brick work! I didn't know about the use of tree sap glue as a masonry binding agent--that's fascinating. The Champa dances were beautiful, as were the dancers. I have a real love for the traditional dances of different cultures. Thank you for a look at My Son Sanctuary Temple, and for the travel tips you gave. What a lovely and informative day trip! Love to you both, and to Nala.  💙💙🖤

comments.author: @stufr.travel
comments.text: We loved My Son so much. The combination of the red bricks and the plants growing in between them was stunning. As was the dance performance. We had a really nice daytrip 😊🙌.  Love back from us. ❤️❤️

comments.author: @eprohoda
comments.text: Hi. Stufr,thank you,total stunning , see you soon.

comments.author: @Nasi-n4w
comments.text:
I'm planning a private tour of My Son Sanctuary early in the morning with my family.
Is there a guide service available on site? If not, do you have any recommendations for a guide who can also take us to My Son from Da Nang or Hoi An?

comments.author: @stufr.travel
comments.text: Our excursion to My Son was booked with our trip. So we don’t have any tips for companies unfortunately. But there are so many operators offering it. So you will be able to get it arranged easily.  Not sure if there are guides at the location, I think so.  Otherwise you can ask the operator or walk around by yourself and enjoy. It is such a stunning place. We wish you a great time 🙌😍👋
